interface.name: prism_surface_effect_manager_v1
interface.description: Describes logical surface-local rounded rectangles and bounded contours. Effects sample only scene content below this surface. State is double buffered and applies with the next wl_surface.commit. Unsupported compositors leave client alpha/tint unchanged. No DSL, draw list or business action is transmitted.

event.name: contour_capabilities
event.description: A nonzero value means add_contour is supported. This supplements the original backdrop capability; version 1 clients receive only that event. Unsupported clients omit contour effects without a rectangular fallback.

event.name: popup_backdrop_capabilities
event.description: A nonzero value declares effects on xdg_popup surfaces. Sampling includes committed parent content and lower scene nodes, excluding this popup and all higher nodes. Coordinates remain logical wl_surface-local, including surface padding outside xdg window geometry. Version 1 and 2 do not declare this capability. Clients retain root fallback when it is required but unavailable; ordinary backdrop capability alone is insufficient.

request.name: add_region
add_contour
request.description: Payload format v1 uses an 8-byte little-endian header: uint16 version 1, uint16 count 3..256, uint16 flags 0 and uint16 reserved 0; followed by count signed int32 Q24.8 x/y pairs. Total length is exactly 8+count*8. Coordinates are within +/-8192 and bounds are at most 8192 per axis. One implicitly closed simple polygon, without holes, self-intersection, self-touching, zero-length edges or degenerate area, is required. Both winding directions use even-odd fill. Blur radius is 0..48. Rounded rectangles and contours share the maximum eight pending regions. Validation precedes mutation; state becomes visible atomically on commit. The contour capability must be supported; no bounding-box fallback is used.
